desc: Implement offline-by-prefix LIS tails solution with queries grouped by R and answers stored by original query id.
Use bisect_left for LIS tails updates to enforce strictly increasing subsequences.
Answer each query with bisect_right(tails, X) after processing prefix R.
Test on sample inputs and edge cases such as duplicates, large X, and X equal to prefix minimum.
If the tails approach fails sample tests, switch to the offline-by-value Fenwick DP fallback.
